construction_scope: Prospective matched fixed-rank encoder and OOD-style independent correlation-difference evaluator over precomputed features and separately held targets.

primary_source_mapping.evidence: Four people sub-01, sub-02, sub-03, sub-05; per-segment HDF5 arrays are samples by 1000 parcels; TR and transcript windows 1.49 s. Friends episode and Movie10 film subdivisions are not independent films; Life and Hidden Figures have repeated viewings.

ID Friends season 7: concatenate episodes before per-parcel/person Pearson (line 72). OOD: independent Pearson per film/parcel/person, then means across parcels, films and persons (line 147). Neither specifies Fisher-z transformation or sample-weighted person pooling.
ID Friends season 7 only: trim each segment prediction and target [5:-5], concatenate all episodes on sample axis, and compute scipy.stats.pearsonr per parcel. This is not the OOD estimator.
Native RidgeCV uses 15 alpha values from 1e6 to 1e-5, cv=None and alpha_per_target=True. This does not establish whole-film cross-validation or matched-capacity ablation qualification.
Default edge trims 5/5, hrf_delay 3, stimulus_window 5. A stricter chosen guard is a prospective recipe and must be named as such.
Pinned repository LICENSE is CC0 1.0 Universal. This is not blanket clearance of original movie media or gated model assets.

Gifford et al., The Algonauts Project 2025 Challenge: How the Human Brain Makes Sense of Multimodal Movies; v2 January 6 2025. Primary abstract identifies multimodal encoding and out-of-distribution generalization.
Loader transposes HDF5 sample-by-parcel data, identifies Friends season/episode/chunk and Movie10 movie/chunk/run, and uses 1.49-second acquisition cadence.

Loop separately over each OOD film. Trim both constituent segments [5:-5], concatenate these two segments, then compute Pearson per parcel for that film. Source-specific Chaplin language handling exists; this review does not qualify multimodal OOD access or reproduction.

exact_source_pins.method: GitHub recursive git tree inspected over HTTPS. Contents read through web primary-source opens. SHA256 byte fetch failed SSL and blob API was rate limited; no fabricated SHA256 values.

rights_status: No organizer code/data/media/weights copied. CC0 repository license identified; media, feature/model assets and packet redistribution remain unqualified.
prospective_choices: Whole-film identity shared over repeated viewings and across people; fixed explicit symmetric guards and causal lags.
Equal-film Pearson aligned to OOD source; repeated segments pooled within each film.
Train-only standardization and PCA whitening with common fixed rank and ridge alpha across four ablation arms.
Unpenalized intercept and analytic whitening ridge, unlike native per-target RidgeCV.
Reject any constant/nonfinite scored target or prediction parcel; no selective parcel deletion.
Descriptive finite frozen within-segment paired circular shifts; synchronized across matching stimulus/run/length.
All 256 four-person bootstrap resamples; descriptive percentile interval only.
Numerical claim verification of group mean full-minus-without-family Pearson delta at absolute tolerance 1e-8.
